explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and at every D2 except when a1 led to S1 (a common transition). On those steps it is about 10 if the previous trial was a rare transition to S2, then drops by about 1 to 2 per trial over a run of common S1 trials (10, 9, 7, 6, 5, 4), ending near 0 to 2 after long runs or early in the episode (before trial about 40).
